verdict.rationale: Salesforce markets Agentforce agents that can be 'turned on across every stage of the deal cycle' and 'deployed 24/7 to autonomously handle repetitive tasks' (docs-18, docs-21), and independent community evidence confirms Salesforce's rule-based automation (e.g., timed emails) is easy to configure compared to competitors (comm-2), suggesting event-triggered automation exists. However, evidence is largely marketing copy without technical documentation of the actual rule/trigger configuration mechanism (e.g., Flow Builder, workflow rules, or agent trigger conditions) for AI-native users. Missing for 10: first-party technical docs on defining trigger conditions/rules, examples of AI-agent-specific event triggers, and independent hands-on validation of building custom automation rules.
